title: Hamilton's Cheapest Gyms
meta_desc: Discover the most affordable gym options in Hamilton, including no-contract deals and Exercise NZ subsidy, with prices starting from $18.99/week
intro: Hamilton's gym scene offers a range of affordable options. City Fitness stands out as the cheapest, with a monthly membership starting at $18.99/week. For those seeking no-contract alternatives, several options are available, including Jetts and Les Mills' Flexi Membership. The Exercise NZ subsidy programme provides the biggest discount available, with 40-70% off for eligible members.

sections.heading: Most Affordable Options
sections.body: The most affordable gym option in Hamilton is City Fitness, with a monthly membership starting at $18.99/week. This price includes access to a full range of equipment and group fitness classes. Another option is Jetts, which offers a no-contract membership with 24/7 access to their facilities.
list: Jetts: prices vary, but typically around $20-25/week

sections.heading: No-Contract Alternatives
sections.body: For those who prefer not to commit to a long-term contract, several no-contract options are available in Hamilton. Jetts offers a no-contract membership, while Les Mills provides a Flexi Membership with no lock-in contract. These options provide flexibility and freedom to cancel or change membership at any time.
list: Les Mills: Flexi Membership with no lock-in contract

sections.heading: Exercise NZ Subsidy
sections.body: The Exercise NZ subsidy can be used in conjunction with other promotions and discounts, making it an excellent way to save even more on gym membership.
